name: AWS Cost Explorer
description: The Sumo Logic App for AWS Cost Explorer lets you visualize, understand, and manage your AWS costs and usage over time.

children.name: AWS Cost Explorer - Account
children.description: This dashboard provides detailed information about cost and usage by different AWS accounts.
children.title: AWS Cost Explorer - Account

queries.queryString:
account={{account}} region CostUsd CostType StartDate EndDate MetricType Granularity Service LinkedAccount Daily
| json "region", "CostUsd", "CostType", "StartDate", "EndDate", "MetricType", "Granularity", "Estimated", "Service"
| json "LinkedAccount" as linkedAccountNumber
| where MetricType matches "{{MetricType}}"
| where Granularity = "Daily" and CostType = "cost_account_region_service_{{MetricType}}_Daily"
| if(isBlank(LinkedAccount), linkedAccountNumber , LinkedAccount) as LinkedAccount
| timeslice 1d
| last(CostUsd) as total_cost by _timeslice, account, region, CostType, Metrictype, Granularity, Estimated, service, LinkedAccount
| sum (total_cost) as total_cost by _timeslice, LinkedAccount, Estimated
| if (Estimated matches "true" ,"Estimated","Actual") as Estimated
| transpose row _timeslice column LinkedAccount, Estimated

account={{account}} region CostUsd CostType StartDate EndDate MetricType Granularity Daily
| json "region", "CostUsd", "CostType", "StartDate", "EndDate", "MetricType", "Granularity", "Estimated"
| where MetricType matches "{{MetricType}}" and estimated matches "{{estimated}}"
| where Granularity = "Daily" and CostType = "cost_region_{{MetricType}}_Daily"
| last(CostUsd) as CostUsd by StartDate, EndDate, account, region, CostType, MetricType, Granularity, Estimated
| sum(CostUsd) as total_cost by StartDate
| sort by StartDate asc

account={{account}} region CostUsd CostType StartDate EndDate MetricType Granularity Service Operation Daily
| json "region", "CostUsd", "CostType", "StartDate", "EndDate", "MetricType", "Granularity", "Estimated", "Service", "Operation"
| where MetricType matches "{{MetricType}}" and estimated matches "{{estimated}}"
| where Granularity = "Daily" and CostType = "cost_service_operation_region_{{MetricType}}_Daily"
| last(CostUsd) as CostUsd by StartDate, EndDate, account, region, CostType, MetricType, Granularity, Estimated, Service, Operation
| sum(CostUsd) as total_cost by Operation
| sort by total_cost, Operation asc
| limit 10

account={{account}} region CostUsd CostType StartDate EndDate MetricType Granularity Service LinkedAccount Daily
| json "region", "CostUsd", "CostType", "StartDate", "EndDate", "MetricType", "Granularity", "Estimated", "Service", "LinkedAccount"
| where Granularity = "Daily" and CostType matches "cost_account_region_service_*_Daily" and estimated matches "{{estimated}}"
| last(CostUsd) as CostUsd by StartDate, EndDate, account, region, CostType, MetricType, Granularity, Estimated, Service, LinkedAccount
| sum(CostUsd) as total_cost by metrictype
| sort by total_cost

account={{account}} region CostUsd CostType StartDate EndDate MetricType Granularity Service LinkedAccount Monthly
| json "region", "CostUsd", "CostType", "StartDate", "EndDate", "MetricType", "Granularity", "Estimated", "Service"
| json "LinkedAccount" as linkedAccountNumber
| where MetricType matches "{{MetricType}}" and estimated matches "{{estimated}}"
| where Granularity = "Monthly" and CostType = "cost_account_region_service_{{MetricType}}_Monthly"
| if(isBlank(LinkedAccount), linkedAccountNumber , LinkedAccount) as LinkedAccount
| last(CostUsd) as CostUsd by StartDate, EndDate, account, region, CostType, MetricType, Granularity, Estimated, LinkedAccount
| sum(CostUsd) as total_cost by LinkedAccount,region
| sort by total_cost, LinkedAccount,region desc
| limit 10
| transpose row region column LinkedAccount

account={{account}} region CostUsd CostType StartDate EndDate MetricType Granularity Service LinkedAccount Monthly
| json "region", "CostUsd", "CostType", "StartDate", "EndDate", "MetricType", "Granularity", "Estimated", "Service"
| json "LinkedAccount" as linkedAccountNumber
| where MetricType matches "{{MetricType}}" and estimated matches "{{estimated}}"
| where Granularity = "Monthly" and CostType = "cost_account_region_service_{{MetricType}}_Monthly"
| if(isBlank(LinkedAccount), linkedAccountNumber , LinkedAccount) as LinkedAccount
| last(CostUsd) as CostUsd by StartDate, EndDate, account, region, CostType, MetricType, Granularity, Estimated, LinkedAccount, Service
| sum(CostUsd) as total_cost by LinkedAccount,Service
| sort by total_cost, LinkedAccount desc
| limit 10
| transpose row Service column LinkedAccount

account={{account}} region CostUsd CostType StartDate EndDate MetricType Granularity Service Operation Monthly
| json "region", "CostUsd", "CostType", "StartDate", "EndDate", "MetricType", "Granularity", "Estimated", "Service", "Operation"
| where MetricType matches "{{MetricType}}" and estimated matches "{{estimated}}"
| where Granularity = "Monthly" and CostType = "cost_service_operation_region_{{MetricType}}_Monthly"
| last(CostUsd) as CostUsd by StartDate, EndDate, account, region, CostType, MetricType, Granularity, Estimated, Service, Operation
| sum(CostUsd) as total_cost by Operation
| sort by total_cost, Operation
| limit 10

panels.title: Note
panels.text:
## Note
* MetricType
  * Refer [AWS cost cheatsheet](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws-cloud-financial-management/understanding-your-aws-cost-datasets-a-cheat-sheet)
* Estimated
  * Use **true** to monitor estimated / forecasted cost. 
  * Use **false** to monitor actual cost. Actual cost is available once in a month after invoice is generated.
* It can take up to 48 hours for [AWS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-what-is.html) to generate your billing data. For accuracy Sumo Logic does not present any billing analysis for the last 48-60 hours.

| if(isBlank(LinkedAccount), linkedAccountNumber , LinkedAccount) as LinkedAccount

account={{account}} region CostUsd CostType StartDate EndDate MetricType Granularity Service LinkedAccount Daily
| json "region", "CostUsd", "CostType", "StartDate", "EndDate", "MetricType", "Granularity", "Estimated", "Service"

  * Refer [AWS cost cheatsheet](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws-cloud-financial-management/understanding-your-aws-cost-datasets-a-cheat-sheet)
* Estimated
  * Use **true** to monitor estimated / forecasted cost. 
  * Use **false** to monitor actual cost. Actual cost is available once in a month after invoice is generated.
* It can take up to 48 hours for [AWS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-what-is.html) to generate your billing data. For accuracy Sumo Logic does not present any billing analysis for the last 48-60 hours.
